input: explicitly synthetic strict CSV with corporate actions

definitions.frequency: last snapshot per New York session date; consecutive daily sessions assumed
definitions.annualization: 252 trading sessions/year; zero risk-free and downside target
definitions.drawdown_duration: maximum consecutive observed underwater sessions; recovery day excluded
definitions.turnover: sum absolute executed notional / mean EOD equity; not annualized or halved
definitions.fee_ratio: explicit commissions / capital immediately before scored period
definitions.market_exposure: mean gross USD position notional / EOD equity
definitions.sample_size: scored daily EOD observations, including initial-capital-to-first return
